The 6 Silent Rules of High Emotional Intelligence. How you react when no one is watching and how you handle yourself when everyone is defines your trajectory in life. In traditional Zen philosophy and modern personal development, true strength isn't about controlling external circumstances. It’s about practicing self-improvement and mindfulness in every environment you step into. Here are 6 timeless principles of emotional self-mastery to live by: 1️⃣When you are alone, mind your thoughts. (一人の時は、己の「想い」を慎む) Solitude reveals your inner narrative. Cultivating positive mental habits during quiet moments is the foundation of long-term stress management and mental clarity. 2️⃣When you are with friends, mind your tongue. (友がいる時は、己の「言葉」を慎む) True connection thrives on respect. Guarding your speech protects valuable relationships and builds deep trust. 3️⃣When you are angry, mind your temper.
